The oracle requires lkg/config.yaml and its record; the baseline produces none.

SCN-CFG-002.evidence: src/main.rs:94-99 returns 'Failed to load configuration' and exits when ConfigManager::load fails; no fallback exists. The oracle requires readiness on the saved copy after the broken YAML.

SCN-CFG-003.evidence: the refusal itself behaves as required at the baseline (src/config.rs:931-946 refuses, src/main.rs:99 exits non-zero, no fallback exists), but the fixture precondition fails: the first start must save an LKG whose digest the oracle compares after the second start, and the baseline never saves one (see SCN-CFG-001).
